本次记录.模组原文:
Magneto-clusters are usually created when several smaller ferrofluid oozes combine. There have, however, been documented cases of these creatures spontaneously appearing after large industrial accidents. Like their smaller "cousins," magneto-cluster oozes seek out sources of electromagnetism. They also search for and consume magnetic objects and metals capable of being magnetized. They completely disregard organic life and usually are only a danger when a life-form doesn't want to relinquish their magnetic material. Some clusters consume so much metal and objects they're mistaken for scavenger slimes. Any metal consumed by a magneto-cluster immediately becomes magnetic.

As living magnetic accelerators, ferrofluid magneto-cluster oozes are capable of launching the metal they collect at high speeds as a defense mechanism. They do so at such high velocities as to make even a simple metal shard accelerate fast enough to puncture high-tech ballistic armor.

Oozes of many types lurk in dark and abandoned places across the galaxy, emerging only to satiate their appetites and threaten adventurers, explorers, and hapless workers alike.

磁力聚合体通常由数个较小的铁流体泥怪结合而成，但也有记录表明，这些生物会在大型工业事故后自发出现。与体型较小的“表亲”一样，磁力聚合体泥怪会寻找电磁源，也会搜寻并吞噬磁性物体及能够被磁化的金属。它们完全无视有机生命，通常只有在生命体不愿交出磁性材料时才会构成危险。一些聚合体吞噬了太多金属和物品，以至于被误认为拾荒黏怪。任何被磁力聚合体吞噬的金属都会立即获得磁性。

作为活体磁力加速器，铁流体磁力聚合体泥怪能够高速发射收集到的金属，以此防卫。其发射速度极高，连一片普通金属碎片都能加速到足以穿透高科技防弹护甲。

银河各处的阴暗废弃之地潜伏着许多种泥怪，它们只为满足食欲才会现身，对冒险者、探险家和不幸的工人构成同样的威胁。

本次记录.模组原文:
Liberoba delivered the Newborn. Many appendages protrude from this creature's bizarre anatomy, each ending in bloody aucturnite shears.

Thirteen mortal Midwives attended the Newborn's birth and were transformed into eldritch beings by the nascent outer god's awakening. A Midwife always regenerates an identical new form so long as even a single speck of aucturnite—the name for the frozen chunks of planetcenta that once surrounded the Newborn—exists on this plane.

There are 13 types of Midwives, but their true numbers are unknown. Whether their names come from the mortal servants whose souls were the kindling for the Midwives' creation or have some other significance to the Newborn, also remains a mystery.

Each Midwife identifies themself by how they cared for the Newborn: if they swaddled, fed, carried, held, watched, warded, blessed, or performed other acts of nurturing for the outer god. The Midwives are powerful beings capable of transdimensional travel. They might be encountered in liminal spaces, such as the Drift or the Ghost Levels of Absalom Station, or they might be found among the clouds of aucturnite debris in the Gelid Edge. Their incomprehensible actions always advance the Newborn's inscrutable agenda—or their own.

The most well-known encounter the Pact Worlds have had with the Midwives took place in the immediate aftermath of the Newborn's birth. Amnieka, who swaddled the Newborn and has a hood of writhing tentacles around their visage, attacked Absalom Station directly, causing a massive power surge that threatened the lives of everyone on board. Chaos ensued, but a group of adventurers—who happened to be in the right elevator at the right time—found themselves in the station's Ghost Levels, where they thwarted Amnieka and prevented the Midwife from draining the station's reactors. The Midwives haven't acted so directly since that incident, but many suspect it's only a matter of time, and no one knows just how powerful the others might be.
本次记录.中文:
利贝罗巴为新诞者接生。众多肢体从这个生物怪异的身体上伸出，每一条的末端都是血淋淋的奥克腾岩剪刀。

十三名凡人接生者照料了新诞者的降生，并因这位初生外神的觉醒而转化成诡异的存在。只要这个位面上还留有哪怕一粒奥克腾岩——曾经包裹新诞者的行星胎盘的冰冻碎块之名——接生圣者便总能再生出一模一样的新躯体。

接生圣者共有13种，但其真正数量无人知晓。他们的名字是否源自那些灵魂被用作创造接生圣者的火种的凡人仆从，或是对新诞者另有含义，同样是个谜。

每名接生圣者都以自己照料新诞者的方式来定义自身：包裹襁褓、喂养、背负、怀抱、守望、看护、祝福，或为这位外神提供其他养育之举。接生圣者是能够跨维度旅行的强大存在。他们可能出现在漂流域、艾布萨罗姆空间站的幽灵层等阈限空间，也可能现身于极寒边域的奥克腾岩碎片云中。他们难以理解的行动总在推进新诞者莫测的计划——或是他们自己的计划。

协约世界与接生圣团最为人熟知的遭遇，就发生在新诞者刚刚降生之后。为新诞者包裹襁褓、脸旁环绕着蠕动触须兜帽的阿姆涅卡直接袭击了艾布萨罗姆空间站，引发巨大能量涌动，危及站内所有人的生命。混乱随之爆发，但一群恰巧在正确时机搭上正确电梯的冒险者来到了空间站的幽灵层，在那里挫败了阿姆涅卡，阻止这名接生圣者汲取空间站反应堆的能量。此事之后，接生圣团再未如此直接地出手，但许多人怀疑这只是时间问题，也没人知道其他接生圣者究竟有多强大。

本次记录.模组原文:
Emganats were first encountered during the Krethiskar subcolony's sudden emergence and the first attacks on Szandite Collective space. These wolf-sized components can burrow beneath the ground, and they move at great speeds to reach a location where they can set up an ambush. Then, once they detect a threat, the emganats spring forth from their burrowed positions and lay into their foes with an acidic cannon located in their mouths. The more emganats that unleash their bio-acid on foes, the faster the substance dissolves their targets in an agonizing display.

Developing far out in the Vast from an insectile species known as kucharns, the Swarm is considered the greatest threat in existence for several cultures. Composed of countless subcolonies, each consisting of myriad component subspecies, the Swarm is a vast host that acts in psychic union for the purpose of consuming all matter across the cosmos. Most frightening of all is the Swarm's ability to assimilate the knowledge and DNA of those they consume. Thanks to its pre-Gap development of star travel, the Swarm had already consumed innumerable systems before history short-circuited, and the Swarm's pace only accelerated once it received access to the Signal and the hyperspace dimension known as the Drift.

Worlds touched by the Swarm are drained of their natural resources and rendered barren places known as huskworlds. What outsiders consider to be "Swarm space" is little more than a swathe of lifeless worlds that the Swarm have consumed in its reckless advance. The Swarm so thoroughly strips these worlds that surveyors struggle to find even trace amounts of inorganic resources, such as rare minerals and water. Few of these huskworlds have been thoroughly explored, as oftentimes exploration awakens inert drones, theorized to have been left behind in case the devoured system was ever colonized and repopulated. Pockets of Swarm activity exist well beyond this region of space, as the Swarm sent out countless subcolonies in the ages before the Gap, and even now, only some of them have reached their intended destinations.

The Swarm is perhaps most known in the current era for two important facts. First, its assault on the Pact Worlds and the Veskarium led to the cessation of hostilities and tenuous alliance between the two powers. Second, the Swarm is the direct ancestor of the shirren species. Having broken away sometime during the Gap, shirrens found succor with the deity Hylax, who was believed to have evolved from a pre-Swarm kucharn and who turned her back on the ravenous entity the Swarm has evolved into.

In recent years, the Swarm had been seen as little more than a distant boogeyman with no activities save for classified actions in the Suskillon system in the Vast. However, the recent discovery of the missing Szandite world of Krethiskar inadvertently awoke a dormant subcolony that had been responsible for the world's consumption. Since then, the newly dubbed Krethiskar subcolony has become a scourge of Near Space, engaged in an active invasion of Szandite Collective worlds and poised to spill over into other powers like the Veskarium and Pact Worlds. This rediscovered subcolony has begun rapid evolution of its components and remains cut off from the wider Swarm, but it still represents a clear danger to Near Space.
本次记录.中文:
人们首次遇见战斗虫，是在克雷西斯卡子群突然现身，并首次袭击桑迪特联合体星域的时候。这些狼一般大小的组件生物能够钻入地下，以极快的速度抵达适合设伏的位置。一旦发现威胁，战斗虫就会从地下的藏身处跃出，用口中的酸液炮猛烈攻击敌人。向敌人喷吐生物酸液的战斗虫越多，这种物质溶解目标的速度就越快，令其痛苦不堪。

虫群由浩界深处一种称为虫族的昆虫状物种发展而来，许多文明认为它是世上最大的威胁。虫群由无数子群组成，每个子群又包含无数组件亚种；这支庞大的群体以心灵联合的方式行动，意图吞噬宇宙中的一切物质。最可怕的是，虫群能够同化被其吞噬者的知识与DNA。由于在大断层之前便已发展出星际旅行技术，虫群在历史中断之前就已经吞噬了无数星系；而在获得信标与名为漂流域的超空间维度后，它们的步伐更是加快了。

被虫群触及的世界会被榨干自然资源，化为称作空壳世界的荒芜之地。外人所谓的“虫群星域”，不过是虫群在肆意进军中吞噬过的一大片死寂世界。虫群将这些世界剥夺得如此彻底，以至于勘探者连稀有矿物和水等无机资源的微量痕迹都难以找到。这些空壳世界很少被彻底探索，因为探索往往会唤醒沉寂的虫群个体。人们推测，它们被留下，是为了应对被吞噬的星系再遭殖民、重新出现居民的情况。远在这片星域之外，也有零星的虫群活动，因为虫群在大断层之前的漫长岁月中派出了无数子群；即使到了今天，也只有部分子群抵达了预定目的地。

在当今时代，虫群最广为人知的或许是两件事。首先，它们对协约世界与维斯卡里姆的进攻，促成了这两大势力停止敌对，并结成脆弱的联盟。其次，虫群是希伦虫人的直系祖先。希伦虫人在大断层期间的某个时候脱离虫群，寻得了神祇海拉丝的庇护。据信，海拉丝由虫群形成之前的虫族进化而来，并背弃了后来演变成贪婪实体的虫群。

近年来，除了在浩界的苏斯基隆星系开展的机密行动之外，虫群并无活动，人们几乎只把它当作遥远的吓人传说。然而，最近人们发现了失踪的桑迪特世界克雷西斯卡，无意间唤醒了曾吞噬这个世界的休眠子群。自此，这个新获名为克雷西斯卡的子群成为了近宇的祸害，正在积极入侵桑迪特联合体的世界，并有蔓延至维斯卡里姆和协约世界等其他势力的趋势。这个被重新发现的子群已开始让其组件快速进化，虽然仍与更广大的虫群隔绝，却已对近宇构成明确威胁。
Wiki对比: Wiki将最终段被入侵的桑迪特联合体世界写为苏斯基隆星系；本译按原文保留桑迪特联合体。
Wiki将Hylax evolved from a pre-Swarm kucharn误为一只进化前的虫族；按模组原文改为由虫群形成之前的虫族进化而来。

本次记录.模组原文:
Alloids are interplanetary scavengers sent by the Dominion of the Black to plague the galaxy. These tall, thin, and spindly creatures appear to have metallic sheens to their smooth skin, often in copper or gold tones. An alloid's surprisingly pliable physiology allows them to mold their physical form to fit into tight spaces or stretch paper-thin against surfaces. It's rumored they can, with great effort, even mimic other people.

While few enough people have encountered alloids for the name to truly catch on, they've become colloquially known as "ship stealers" in the Pact Worlds. They frequently travel in groups of three to five, hanging around spaceports and scoping out potential marks. They often look for smaller ships with crews not much larger than their pack or massive ships with many hiding places. They then slip aboard inside containers or backpacks, often during resupply cycles.

Once the ship is out in space and the crew settled in, the pack gets to work, ideally taking out their targets one by one with barbs that make their prey's flesh as malleable as their own, allowing them to easily hide the bodies. After kidnapping a crew, they fly the ship to places where they can link up with other alloids—or their Dominion masters—to strip the starship for parts. What they do with their living prey is unknown.

Before the Gap, the Dominion of the Black had a strong presence on Aucturn and would occasionally invade other planets, such as Lost Golarion, in search of brains to devour and in pursuit of other mysterious agendas. Now, the people of the Pact Worlds understand that the Dominion has secret bases across the galaxy—the Pact Worlds might draw their attention from time to time, but their missions take them to many worlds and many star systems.

The Dominion creatures most commonly seen by others are mere scouts, while more powerful members of the Dominion conglomeration emerge only rarely to terrorize society. Stories of these creatures are as few as the scant number of people who survive such encounters—most spacefarers know to immediately flee any ship or territory with signs of Dominion presence.
本次记录.中文:
金肤怪是黑色支配者派来祸害星系的星际拾荒者。这些高挑、瘦长的生物有着光滑的皮肤，表面似乎泛着金属光泽，通常呈铜色或金色。金肤怪的身体结构柔韧得惊人，能塑造形体以钻进狭窄空间，或摊得像纸一样薄，贴附在表面。据说，只要付出很大努力，它们甚至能模仿其他人。

虽然遇到过金肤怪的人还不够多，这个名字尚未真正流传开来，但在协约世界，它们已被俗称为“飞船窃贼”（ship stealers）。它们经常三到五个结群，在太空港徘徊，物色潜在目标。它们常寻找船员数量比自身小群规模多不了多少的小船，或拥有许多藏身处的大船，然后通常趁补给时，躲进容器或背包偷偷登船。

飞船进入太空、船员安顿下来后，这些金肤怪便会行动。最理想的做法是用毒刺逐个制服目标，使猎物的血肉变得与它们自身一样可塑，便于藏匿身体。绑架船员后，它们会把飞船开到可以与其他金肤怪——或它们的支配者主人——会合的地方，将星舰拆解成零件。它们如何处置活着的猎物，至今无人知晓。

大断层之前，黑色支配者在奥克腾拥有强大势力，偶尔会入侵其他星球，例如失落的格拉利昂，寻找可以吞食的大脑，并执行其他神秘计划。如今，协约世界的居民明白，支配者在星系各处设有秘密基地——协约世界或许时不时会吸引它们的注意，但它们的任务遍及众多世界和恒星系。

外人最常见到的支配者生物只是斥候，支配者共同体中更强大的成员仅偶尔现身，给社会带来恐怖。关于这些生物的故事，就像能从这类遭遇中幸存的人数一样寥寥无几——大多数太空旅行者都知道，一旦发现舰船或领地有支配者存在的迹象，就应立即逃离。
Wiki对比: Wiki第2与第3段合为一段且附原文未有quote，按模组分段恢复并不加入quote。

角色包完整Wiki差异.模组原文:
Magneto-clusters are usually created when several smaller ferrofluid oozes combine. There have, however, been documented cases of these creatures spontaneously appearing after large industrial accidents. Like their smaller "cousins," magneto-cluster oozes seek out sources of electromagnetism. They also search for and consume magnetic objects and metals capable of being magnetized. They completely disregard organic life and usually are only a danger when a life-form doesn't want to relinquish their magnetic material. Some clusters consume so much metal and objects they're mistaken for scavenger slimes. Any metal consumed by a magneto-cluster immediately becomes magnetic.

As living magnetic accelerators, ferrofluid magneto-cluster oozes are capable of launching the metal they collect at high speeds as a defense mechanism. They do so at such high velocities as to make even a simple metal shard accelerate fast enough to puncture high-tech ballistic armor.

Oozes of many types lurk in dark and abandoned places across the galaxy, emerging only to satiate their appetites and threaten adventurers, explorers, and hapless workers alike.

角色包完整Wiki差异.模组原文:
Liberoba delivered the Newborn. Many appendages protrude from this creature's bizarre anatomy, each ending in bloody aucturnite shears.

Thirteen mortal Midwives attended the Newborn's birth and were transformed into eldritch beings by the nascent outer god's awakening. A Midwife always regenerates an identical new form so long as even a single speck of aucturnite—the name for the frozen chunks of planetcenta that once surrounded the Newborn—exists on this plane.

There are 13 types of Midwives, but their true numbers are unknown. Whether their names come from the mortal servants whose souls were the kindling for the Midwives' creation or have some other significance to the Newborn, also remains a mystery.

Each Midwife identifies themself by how they cared for the Newborn: if they swaddled, fed, carried, held, watched, warded, blessed, or performed other acts of nurturing for the outer god. The Midwives are powerful beings capable of transdimensional travel. They might be encountered in liminal spaces, such as the Drift or the Ghost Levels of Absalom Station, or they might be found among the clouds of aucturnite debris in the Gelid Edge. Their incomprehensible actions always advance the Newborn's inscrutable agenda—or their own.

The most well-known encounter the Pact Worlds have had with the Midwives took place in the immediate aftermath of the Newborn's birth. Amnieka, who swaddled the Newborn and has a hood of writhing tentacles around their visage, attacked Absalom Station directly, causing a massive power surge that threatened the lives of everyone on board. Chaos ensued, but a group of adventurers—who happened to be in the right elevator at the right time—found themselves in the station's Ghost Levels, where they thwarted Amnieka and prevented the Midwife from draining the station's reactors. The Midwives haven't acted so directly since that incident, but many suspect it's only a matter of time, and no one knows just how powerful the others might be.
角色包完整Wiki差异.translation:

十三名凡人接生者照料了新诞者的降生，并因这位初生外神的觉醒而转化成诡异的存在。只要这个位面上还留有哪怕一粒奥克腾岩——曾经包裹新诞者的行星胎盘的冰冻碎块之名——接生圣者便总能再生出一模一样的新躯体。

接生圣者共有13种，但其真正数量无人知晓。他们的名字是否源自那些灵魂被用作创造接生圣者的火种的凡人仆从，或是对新诞者另有含义，同样是个谜。

每名接生圣者都以自己照料新诞者的方式来定义自身：包裹襁褓、喂养、背负、怀抱、守望、看护、祝福，或为这位外神提供其他养育之举。接生圣者是能够跨维度旅行的强大存在。他们可能出现在漂流域、艾布萨罗姆空间站的幽灵层等阈限空间，也可能现身于极寒边域的奥克腾岩碎片云中。他们难以理解的行动总在推进新诞者莫测的计划——或是他们自己的计划。

协约世界与接生圣团最为人熟知的遭遇，就发生在新诞者刚刚降生之后。为新诞者包裹襁褓、脸旁环绕着蠕动触须兜帽的阿姆涅卡直接袭击了艾布萨罗姆空间站，引发巨大能量涌动，危及站内所有人的生命。混乱随之爆发，但一群恰巧在正确时机搭上正确电梯的冒险者来到了空间站的幽灵层，在那里挫败了阿姆涅卡，阻止这名接生圣者汲取空间站反应堆的能量。此事之后，接生圣团再未如此直接地出手，但许多人怀疑这只是时间问题，也没人知道其他接生圣者究竟有多强大。

These wolf-sized components can burrow beneath the ground, and they move at great speeds to reach a location where they can set up an ambush. Then, once they detect a threat, the emganats spring forth from their burrowed positions and lay into their foes with an acidic cannon located in their mouths. Developing far out in the Vast from an insectile species known as kucharns, the Swarm is considered the greatest threat in existence for several cultures. Composed of countless subcolonies, each consisting of myriad component subspecies, the Swarm is a vast host that acts in psychic union for the purpose of consuming all matter across the cosmos. Most frightening of all is the Swarm's ability to assimilate the knowledge and DNA of those they consume. Thanks to its pre-Gap development of star travel, the Swarm had already consumed innumerable systems before history short-circuited, and the Swarm's pace only accelerated once it received access to the Signal and the hyperspace dimension known as the Drift.

Worlds touched by the Swarm are drained of their natural resources and rendered barren places known as huskworlds. What outsiders consider to be "Swarm space" is little more than a swathe of lifeless worlds that the Swarm have consumed in its reckless advance. The Swarm so thoroughly strips these worlds that surveyors struggle to find even trace amounts of inorganic resources, such as rare minerals and water. Few of these huskworlds have been thoroughly explored, as oftentimes exploration awakens inert drones, theorized to have been left behind in case the devoured system was ever colonized and repopulated. Pockets of Swarm activity exist well beyond this region of space, as the Swarm sent out countless subcolonies in the ages before the Gap, and even now, only some of them have reached their intended destinations.

The Swarm is perhaps most known in the current era for two important facts. First, its assault on the Pact Worlds and the Veskarium led to the cessation of hostilities and tenuous alliance between the two powers. Second, the Swarm is the direct ancestor of the shirren species. Having broken away sometime during the Gap, shirrens found succor with the deity Hylax, who was believed to have evolved from a pre-Swarm kucharn and who turned her back on the ravenous entity the Swarm has evolved into.

In recent years, the Swarm had been seen as little more than a distant boogeyman with no activities save for classified actions in the Suskillon system in the Vast. However, the recent discovery of the missing Szandite world of Krethiskar inadvertently awoke a dormant subcolony that had been responsible for the world's consumption. Since then, the newly dubbed Krethiskar subcolony has become a scourge of Near Space, engaged in an active invasion of Szandite Collective worlds and poised to spill over into other powers like the Veskarium and Pact Worlds. This rediscovered subcolony has begun rapid evolution of its components and remains cut off from the wider Swarm, but it still represents a clear danger to Near Space.

虫群由浩界深处一种称为虫族的昆虫状物种发展而来，许多文明认为它是世上最大的威胁。虫群由无数子群组成，每个子群又包含无数组件亚种；这支庞大的群体以心灵联合的方式行动，意图吞噬宇宙中的一切物质。最可怕的是，虫群能够同化被其吞噬者的知识与DNA。由于在大断层之前便已发展出星际旅行技术，虫群在历史中断之前就已经吞噬了无数星系；而在获得信标与名为漂流域的超空间维度后，它们的步伐更是加快了。

被虫群触及的世界会被榨干自然资源，化为称作空壳世界的荒芜之地。外人所谓的“虫群星域”，不过是虫群在肆意进军中吞噬过的一大片死寂世界。虫群将这些世界剥夺得如此彻底，以至于勘探者连稀有矿物和水等无机资源的微量痕迹都难以找到。这些空壳世界很少被彻底探索，因为探索往往会唤醒沉寂的虫群个体。人们推测，它们被留下，是为了应对被吞噬的星系再遭殖民、重新出现居民的情况。远在这片星域之外，也有零星的虫群活动，因为虫群在大断层之前的漫长岁月中派出了无数子群；即使到了今天，也只有部分子群抵达了预定目的地。

在当今时代，虫群最广为人知的或许是两件事。首先，它们对协约世界与维斯卡里姆的进攻，促成了这两大势力停止敌对，并结成脆弱的联盟。其次，虫群是希伦虫人的直系祖先。希伦虫人在大断层期间的某个时候脱离虫群，寻得了神祇海拉丝的庇护。据信，海拉丝由虫群形成之前的虫族进化而来，并背弃了后来演变成贪婪实体的虫群。

Lumocanthas seek the light and warmth of the sun, drooping and becoming less active in prolonged darkness. These unusually strong and flexible roots can also be readily withdrawn from the ground and used for mobility, allowing lumocanthas to migrate as needed as they seek better soil or light conditions.

Lumocanthas are mindless, relying on pure instinct for survival. When affected by magical darkness, lumocanthas immediately move toward the nearest light source, though they still defend themselves as they do. If lumocanthas remain in darkness for 3 hours, they start to droop and become sluggish. Even when dormant, they can still use their lasers; however, if trapped in total darkness for 1 week, they temporarily lose their laser abilities. This vulnerability allows the plants to be safely transported, though if kept in total darkness for 2 weeks, lumocanthas eventually starve.

Although first documented on Vesk-6, lumocanthas are found throughout the galaxy, wherever suitable conditions exist—even sometimes acting as decorative security measures. Young lumocanthas measure 2 to 3 feet across and approximately 5 feet high when unfurled in the light. 角色包完整Wiki差异.模组原文:
Alloids are interplanetary scavengers sent by the Dominion of the Black to plague the galaxy. These tall, thin, and spindly creatures appear to have metallic sheens to their smooth skin, often in copper or gold tones. An alloid's surprisingly pliable physiology allows them to mold their physical form to fit into tight spaces or stretch paper-thin against surfaces. It's rumored they can, with great effort, even mimic other people.

While few enough people have encountered alloids for the name to truly catch on, they've become colloquially known as "ship stealers" in the Pact Worlds. They frequently travel in groups of three to five, hanging around spaceports and scoping out potential marks. They often look for smaller ships with crews not much larger than their pack or massive ships with many hiding places. They then slip aboard inside containers or backpacks, often during resupply cycles.

Once the ship is out in space and the crew settled in, the pack gets to work, ideally taking out their targets one by one with barbs that make their prey's flesh as malleable as their own, allowing them to easily hide the bodies. After kidnapping a crew, they fly the ship to places where they can link up with other alloids—or their Dominion masters—to strip the starship for parts. What they do with their living prey is unknown.

Before the Gap, the Dominion of the Black had a strong presence on Aucturn and would occasionally invade other planets, such as Lost Golarion, in search of brains to devour and in pursuit of other mysterious agendas. Now, the people of the Pact Worlds understand that the Dominion has secret bases across the galaxy—the Pact Worlds might draw their attention from time to time, but their missions take them to many worlds and many star systems.

The Dominion creatures most commonly seen by others are mere scouts, while more powerful members of the Dominion conglomeration emerge only rarely to terrorize society. Stories of these creatures are as few as the scant number of people who survive such encounters—most spacefarers know to immediately flee any ship or territory with signs of Dominion presence.

虽然遇到过金肤怪的人还不够多，这个名字尚未真正流传开来，但在协约世界，它们已被俗称为“飞船窃贼”（ship stealers）。它们经常三到五个结群，在太空港徘徊，物色潜在目标。它们常寻找船员数量比自身小群规模多不了多少的小船，或拥有许多藏身处的大船，然后通常趁补给时，躲进容器或背包偷偷登船。

飞船进入太空、船员安顿下来后，这些金肤怪便会行动。最理想的做法是用毒刺逐个制服目标，使猎物的血肉变得与它们自身一样可塑，便于藏匿身体。绑架船员后，它们会把飞船开到可以与其他金肤怪——或它们的支配者主人——会合的地方，将星舰拆解成零件。它们如何处置活着的猎物，至今无人知晓。

大断层之前，黑色支配者在奥克腾拥有强大势力，偶尔会入侵其他星球，例如失落的格拉利昂，寻找可以吞食的大脑，并执行其他神秘计划。如今，协约世界的居民明白，支配者在星系各处设有秘密基地——协约世界或许时不时会吸引它们的注意，但它们的任务遍及众多世界和恒星系。

外人最常见到的支配者生物只是斥候，支配者共同体中更强大的成员仅偶尔现身，给社会带来恐怖。关于这些生物的故事，就像能从这类遭遇中幸存的人数一样寥寥无几——大多数太空旅行者都知道，一旦发现舰船或领地有支配者存在的迹象，就应立即逃离。

Despite lacking ears, these quadrupeds stalk prey with an enhanced sight and sense of smell. Akatas typically stand at about 3-1/2 feet tall and weigh 400 pounds.

Most garaggakals are around 8 feet tall, weighing 400 pounds, with a 20-foot wingspan. Always on the move, they might find a temporary lair on a broken starship or floating chunk of terrain but are soon off again, in search of a new creature to be their next meal. The Drift is a strange place, and the creatures native to it are stranger still. Garaggakals prove no exception. Shaped vaguely like humanoids, they have arms and legs but also sallow, rubbery skin with long, scaly tails and gauzelike wings. Most horrifyingly, their faces are almost entirely taken up by their enormous, funnel-like mouth, lined with sharp teeth. While they use these mouths for the obvious purpose of biting, they can also use its powerful suction to draw actual life force from their prey.

Also known as "Drift wraiths," garaggakals hunt down any living creatures that linger too long in the Drift. For garaggakals, anything that isn't a fellow garaggakal is prey. However, they're no mere mindless hunters. Garaggakals are surprisingly intelligent and prefer to dissect victims, learning all about them before eating them. Often, garaggakals take their victims apart while they're still alive. Xenobiologists have determined that garaggakals don't even technically need to eat to survive, so their relentless hunger is seemingly psychological. They do require the energy of the Drift to survive in the absence of food, however, and further need the energy of the Drift to reproduce, seeking out areas of intense radiation to absorb and then build a new offspring from their own cells. Their children are fully grown at creation.

Garaggakals surprise their prey. They are quite stealthy and can even phase through solid matter, suddenly appearing on the inside of a starship—bad news for whatever living creatures happen to be inside.
